summary_1line: Krishna meditates on the dying Bhishma, urging Yudhishthira to learn from him before his passing, as Bhishma on his arrow-bed praises Krishna as the Supreme.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna sits utterly motionless in deep meditation while Yudhishthira watches in awe, comparing him to a steady lamp-flame in a windless place.
Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows surrounded by gathered sages, radiant like the sun, with palms joined as he hymns Krishna.
Krishna’s jeweled chariot with the Garuda banner is yoked with golden-trapped horses, shining like the morning sun as it is prepared to depart.
